title: EmoMind: Decoding Affective Captions from Human Brain fMRI
abstract: arXiv:2605.16739v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Decoding visual experience from brain activity has advanced substantially, but current brain-to-text systems largely recover semantic content while discarding affect. Additionally, language models can generate emotional text when prompted with categorical labels, but such labels collapse rich inter-subject variability into coarse discrete bins. We present EmoMind, the first end-to-end pipeline for decoding affective captions directly from fMRI signals. EmoMind first retrieves a semantically grounded neutral scene description from brain-decoded visual features, then rewrites it using a continuous 34-dimensional emotion vector decoded from the same fMRI recording. To control the balance between content preservation and affective expression, we train the rewriter with classifier-free guidance against an identity-preserving null branch, enabling smooth interpolation between semantic fidelity and affective expressivity. translated_title: EmoMind：从人脑fMRI信号解码情感图像描述
translated_abstract: 从大脑活动中解码视觉体验的研究已取得长足进展，但当前的脑到文本系统主要恢复语义内容而丢弃情感信息。此外，语言模型虽然在给定分类标签提示时能够生成情感文本，但这类标签将丰富的个体间差异压缩成粗糙的离散类别。我们提出了EmoMind，这是首个直接从fMRI信号解码情感图像描述的端到端流程。EmoMind首先从脑解码的视觉特征中检索语义基础的中性场景描述，然后使用从同一fMRI记录中解码出的连续34维情感向量对其进行重写。为了控制内容保留与情感表达之间的平衡，我们采用无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance）并结合一个保持身份的空分支来训练重写器，从而实现语义保真度与情感表现力之间的平滑插值。
tldr: EmoMind是首个从fMRI信号端到端解码情感图像描述的系统，通过先检索中性场景描述、再利用34维连续情感向量进行重写，并借助无分类器引导实现语义保真与情感表达的灵活平衡。
en_tdlr: EmoMind is the first end-to-end pipeline decoding affective captions directly from fMRI signals, which retrieves neutral scene descriptions and rewrites them with a continuous 34-dimensional emotion vector, using classifier-free guidance to smoothly balance semantic fidelity and emotional expressivity.
